nodes.summary: Structure of abelian groups: finite and finitely generated abelian groups (invariant factors, elementary divisors, torsion, ranks, dual groups), torsion-free and infinite abelian groups (Baer–Specker group, pure subgroups, direct-sum cancellation, ultraproducts of abelian groups); colourings and partitions of abelian groups go to Combinatorics in groups.
nodes.title: Abelian groups

nodes.summary: Automorphism and endomorphism groups of groups other than free groups: their orders and realizations, outer automorphism groups, class-preserving automorphisms, and automorphisms with few fixed points or twisted conjugacy classes.
nodes.title: Automorphisms of groups

nodes.summary: Complex characters and representations used to study finite groups: class functions and orthogonality, irreducible character bases, character degrees and values, McKay conjecture, rational groups, permutation characters, blocks of defect zero, Frobenius group determinant, convolution on finite groups, and Burnside's p^a q^b theorem; general representation theory of algebras and Lie groups belongs to…
nodes.title: Characters of finite groups

nodes.summary: Additive and Ramsey-type combinatorics inside groups: approximate subgroups and product theorems, small doubling, partitions and colourings of groups, dense and coset-free partitions, subset factorizations, products of large normal subsets.
nodes.title: Combinatorics in groups

nodes.summary: Commutator calculus and nilpotency in (often infinite) groups: basic commutators, Engel elements, locally nilpotent and hypercentral groups, metabelian and polycyclic groups, localization of nilpotent groups, commutator width and length, word maps and their images, and local word identities.
nodes.title: Commutators, word maps and Engel conditions

nodes.summary: Conjugacy classes of groups as a structural invariant: class sizes and breadth, the class number, commuting probability, Thompson's conjecture on class sizes, products of conjugacy classes, and relations between class sizes and group structure; class sizes of p-groups go to Finite p-groups, and character-theoretic class arguments to Characters of finite groups.
nodes.title: Conjugacy classes

nodes.summary: Extensions and complements (Schur–Zassenhaus), splitting of extensions, homology and first cohomology of groups, cohomological dimension, and integrability of groups as derived subgroups.
nodes.title: Group extensions and cohomology

nodes.summary: Groups of prime-power order: composition series, Frattini subgroups and Φ-extensions, special, powerful, metacyclic and Camina p-groups, conjugacy class sizes of p-groups, generalized quaternion groups, coclass and rank analogues, derived length bounds, and orders of automorphism groups of p-groups only when the p-group structure is the point.
nodes.title: Finite p-groups

nodes.summary: Finite simple and almost simple groups and the local analysis behind their classification: specific simple groups (Mathieu, Suzuki, PSL), strongly embedded subgroups (Bender–Suzuki), classification by Sylow 2-subgroups (Gorenstein–Walter, Brauer–Suzuki), Baer–Suzuki, Glauberman Z*, Brauer–Fowler, involution centralizers and 3-transpositions; generation questions go to Generation of groups and spectrum recognition…
nodes.title: Finite simple groups and involutions

nodes.summary: Free groups and free metabelian groups: subgroups (inert, compressed, retracts, fixed subgroups), elements (primitive, test, orbit-blocking words, normal closures), and the groups Aut(F_n), Out(F_n) and IA-automorphisms; equations over free groups go to Varieties, quasivarieties and equations, and commutator length to Commutators, word maps and Engel conditions.
nodes.title: Free groups and their automorphisms

nodes.summary: Minimal and special generating sets: generator numbers of almost simple and soluble groups, (2,3)-generation, generation by elements of prime-power order, spread, coprime generation, two-generated direct powers, Eulerian functions and probabilistic generation.
nodes.title: Generation of groups

nodes.summary: Large-scale and analytic properties of finitely generated groups: growth, word-hyperbolic groups and their quotients, amenability and Følner sets, elementary amenable groups, property (T), soficity and permutation stability.
nodes.title: Geometric group theory

nodes.summary: Group rings and group algebras: unit and zero-divisor questions (Kaplansky unit conjecture), Zassenhaus conjectures, augmentation and dimension subgroups, Ore conditions, Jordan decomposition, projective modules over group rings.
nodes.title: Group rings

nodes.summary: Groups of matrices over fields and rings: SL2, PGL2 and SU(2) and their conjugacy and subgroups (Dickson's classification), Jordan, Malcev and Selberg theorems, transvections, eigenvalues of elements of prime order, and linearity of specific groups.
nodes.title: Linear groups

nodes.summary: Left-, right- and bi-orderable groups: spaces of orders, generalized torsion, unique product groups, relatively convex subgroups, orderability of homeomorphism groups and amalgams, and decision problems for orderable groups.
nodes.title: Orderable groups

nodes.summary: Arithmetic of finite groups through orders: cyclic numbers and groups of a given order (groups of order 10, dihedral groups from an index-two cyclic subgroup), counts of elements of each order, the spectrum (set of element orders), recognition of groups by spectrum or by order and spectrum, Thompson's type, and totient sums; conjugacy-class sizes go to Conjugacy classes.
nodes.title: Group orders, element orders and spectra

nodes.summary: Infinite groups defined by torsion and finiteness conditions: Burnside problems and free Burnside groups, Golod groups, Tarski monsters, locally finite simple groups, periodic Frobenius groups, minimal and weak chain conditions, and embeddings into simple periodic groups.
nodes.title: Periodic and locally finite groups

nodes.summary: Groups acting on sets: orbits, stabilizers, fixed-point counts, transitivity, bases, closures, Frobenius groups, symmetric and alternating groups as permutation groups, and infinite permutation groups (highly homogeneous, cofinitary, oligomorphic, subdegree-finite).
nodes.title: Permutation groups and group actions

nodes.summary: Combinatorial group theory: presentations, one-relator groups, HNN extensions and embeddings, SQ-universality, finitely presented simple groups, the word and conjugacy problems (Novikov–Boone, Boone–Higman), Andrews–Curtis moves, generic properties of presentations and torsion quotients.
nodes.title: Presentations and decision problems

nodes.summary: Groups with topology or approximated by finite quotients: profinite and pro-p groups, residual finiteness and separability, profinite rigidity, Golod–Shafarevich inequality, just-infinite groups, totally disconnected locally compact groups, group topologies, Lie groups and their dense subgroups.
nodes.title: Profinite and topological groups

nodes.summary: Structure of finite soluble groups: supersolubility criteria, p-solubility and p-length, chief factors and their complements, σ-solubility and σ-nilpotency, Schmidt subgroups, derived length bounds for finite groups of special type, and factorized groups; classes of groups closed under operations go to Formations and Fitting classes.
nodes.title: Soluble and supersoluble finite groups

nodes.summary: How subgroups sit inside a group: subnormal, permutable, propermutable, pronormal, polynormal and paranormal subgroups, maximal subgroups and their conjugates, intersections of conjugates of nilpotent subgroups and injectors with the Fitting subgroup, centralizer lattices and complemented subgroup lattices.
nodes.title: Subgroup embedding and subgroup lattices

nodes.summary: Sylow theory and its generalization to sets of primes: Hall π-subgroups, the classes E_π, C_π and D_π, pronormality and intersections of Hall subgroups, groups whose maximal subgroups are Hall; questions on supplements of Sylow maximal subgroups forcing solubility go to Soluble and supersoluble finite groups.
nodes.title: Sylow and Hall subgroups

nodes.summary: Groups defined by laws and quasi-identities: varieties, relatively free groups, test ranks, quasivarieties and their lattices, Hall's verbal conjectures, plus equations over groups, equationally Noetherian groups, geometric equivalence and elementary theories of groups.
nodes.title: Varieties, quasivarieties and equations

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
